cues.zh: 有趣的是，我把……我可以把这次演讲本身也放到抽象层级里。对吧？所以这次演讲本身在抽象层级上将是极其抽象的，

cues.en: would be very vague,
cues.zh: 会非常模糊，

cues.en: which ironically, again, by my own definition is probably the most useless talk of this conference.
cues.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，按照我自己的定义，这可能又是本次大会最无用的一场演讲。

cues.en: But but
cues.zh: 但是

cues.en: but now you know that the definition is actually consistent. Right?
cues.zh: 但是现在你知道这个定义其实是自洽的了。对吧？

cues.en: It it is also by my definition and without any emotional attachment,
cues.zh: 按照我的定义，且不带任何情感色彩，

cues.en: a very powerful talk in in a sense that if you can master the levels of abstraction
cues.zh: 这也是一场非常有力量的演讲——从某种意义上说，如果你能掌握抽象层级

cues.en: and drill down these these ladders yourself,
cues.zh: 并亲自在这些阶梯上下钻，

cues.en: then you can potentially apply this paradigm just like I did to various use cases,
cues.zh: 那么你就有可能像我一样，将这种范式应用到各种用例中，

cues.en: to a lot of these concrete use cases, but only if you apply these things. If you don't apply it, if you just bike shit and you... If you think in theory only about this level of of abstractions,
cues.zh: 应用到大量具体的用例中，但前提是你得去应用这些东西。如果你不去应用，如果你只是瞎扯……如果你在理论上只考虑这个抽象层级，

cues.en: then you won't be finding much use for this talk at all. So I urge you to think about all these. Next time you write a library, next time you write an app, you start something new. Try to think in terms of abstractions and where you want to be before starting to actually code and execute.
cues.zh: 那你根本不会觉得这场演讲有什么用。所以我敦促你们好好想想所有这些。下次你写库、写 App、或者开始做新东西的时候，在真正开始编写和执行代码之前，试着用抽象的思维去思考，想想你想达到什么位置。
